newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices fall at several sites.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices fall at several sites.

text.p: Millfeed prices moved lower to sharply lower at several locations in reaction to increased supplies and to lower corn prices, dealers said.

"They were just too high, and people were taking them out of the (feed) formulas," said a North Texas dealer, who said September millfeed traded at $130 per ton Wednesday versus offers of $145 Tuesday.
Buffalo dealers said the recent increase in flour mill run times to six days a week from five added supply-side pressure to prices.

But Buffalo dealers said some of that increased production was shipped to southeast U.S. markets, where higher prices more than offset shipping costs. Millfeed delivered to the western Carolinas was quoted at $135 through September, while Buffalo was offered at $112.
Carolina sources said demand remains strong and area mills have sold out most of their near term production.
